question: With vaginal ultrasound, from how long after conception is it possible to see an embryo with a heartbeat?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Conception -> Embryo implantation -> Gestational sac visible on ultrasound -> 80% CHAIN: Gestational sac visible -> Fetal pole formation -> Fetal heartbeat detectable -> 90% CHAIN: Fetal heartbeat detectable -> Between 42 to 49 days after conception -> 80%
analysis: Based on medical knowledge, with vaginal ultrasound, it is possible to see an embryo with a heartbeat between 21 and 28 days after conception.
